note: correlation rises monotonically across the entire biologically plausible range used in gameplay (td 0.4-2.5 s -> corr 0.24-0.46) and only peaks once td approaches the 15 s block length itself (corr 0.84 at td=10-15 s), then falls again as the kernel outlasts the block. A fit to this design would be pulled toward a 10-15 s decay regardless of the true, much shorter value -- and the plateau near that peak (0.80-0.84 for td 8-20 s) means even block-scale decays are not sharply resolved. The design simply cannot tell a transient, event-locked decay from a sustained, block-locked one.
